name: L8 Editor
body: `editor-core` and `editor-backend` behind the same `lantern_editor.h`, built with `nox build --static-library`, so the Penumbra shell links Nox instead of Rust.

comments.text: Done. editor-core's tests run as tests/editor programs (#33-#35), and backend.rs's three through engine/editor-backend/tests/lantern_editor_test.c, plus tests/editorbackend (#36). The world editor runs on the Nox library and renders byte-identically to Rust (reviewer, #36 and #37). apps/world-editor's sources needed one change that isn't about the backend: Umbra/IViewportRenderer.h became Equinox, after the upstream rename. cmake/EditorBackend.cmake gained LANTERN_EDITOR_BACKEND (nox by default, rust to compare). Merged in #33-#37.

acceptance_criteria.text: The world editor's Rust tests pass as `nox test` programs
The editor shell runs on the Nox library with no change to `apps/world-editor/`

definition_of_done.text: PR into `nox-proto`, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
